# التمرين 1: القراءة والأفعال الأساسية

## 1.1

```{r}
flights <- read_csv(
  "data/flights.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    .default  = col_guess(),
    flight    = col_character(),
    time_hour = col_datetime()
  )
)
airlines <- read_csv("data/airlines.csv", col_types = "cc")

problems(flights)
glimpse(flights)
```

## 1.2

```{r}
flights %>%
  filter(!is.na(arr_delay)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_arr_delay = mean(arr_delay), .by = dest) %>%
  filter(n >= 1000) %>%
  slice_max(mean_arr_delay, n = 5)
```

## 1.3

```{r}
flights %>%
  mutate(dist_cat = case_when(
    distance < 500  ~ "short",
    distance < 1500 ~ "medium",
    .default        = "long"
  )) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_arr_delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = dist_cat)
```

**إضافي:** نسبة الرحلات الملغاة لكل مطار.

```{r}
flights %>%
  summarise(n = n(), p_cancelled = mean(is.na(dep_time)), .by = origin)
```

# التمرين 2: dplyr المتقدم

## 2.1

```{r}
flights %>%
  summarise(
    across(ends_with("_delay"),
           list(mean   = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                median = \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                sd     = \(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    n = n(),
    .by = carrier
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(dep_delay_mean))
```

## 2.2

```{r}
flights %>%
  count(origin, month, day, name = "n_flights") %>%
  arrange(origin, month, day) %>%
  mutate(change = n_flights - lag(n_flights), .by = origin) %>%
  mutate(rank_in_month = min_rank(desc(n_flights)), .by = c(origin, month)) %>%
  filter(origin == "JFK", month == 1)
```

## 2.3

```{r}
flights %>%
  count(dest, carrier) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), .by = dest) %>%
  slice_max(share, n = 1, by = dest, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

## 2.4 إضافي

```{r}
flights %>%
  reframe(q = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
          distance = quantile(distance, q),
          .by = origin)
```

# التمرين 3: tidyr

## 3.1

```{r}
gapminder_wide <- read_csv("data/gapminder.csv")

gapminder <- gapminder_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -c(continent, country),
    names_to  = c(".value", "year"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

gapminder

life_by_continent <- gapminder %>%
  summarise(mean_lifeExp = mean(lifeExp), .by = c(continent, year))
life_by_continent
```

## 3.2

```{r}
life_by_continent %>%
  mutate(mean_lifeExp = round(mean_lifeExp, 1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_lifeExp)
```

## 3.3

```{r}
carrier_month <- flights %>%
  count(carrier, month) %>%
  complete(carrier, month = 1:12, fill = list(n = 0))

carrier_month %>%
  filter(n == 0) %>%
  distinct(carrier)

carrier_month %>%
  filter(carrier == "OO") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = n)
```

# التمرين 4: ربط الجداول

## 4.1

```{r}
flights %>%
  count(carrier, name = "n_flights") %>%
  left_join(airlines, by = join_by(carrier),
            relationship = "one-to-one", unmatched = "error") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_flights))
```

## 4.2

```{r}
seasons <- tribble(
  ~season,  ~from_month, ~to_month,
  "Q1",      1,  3,
  "Q2",      4,  6,
  "Q3",      7,  9,
  "Q4",     10, 12
)

flights %>%
  inner_join(seasons, by = join_by(month >= from_month, month <= to_month)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = season)
```

## 4.3

```{r}
airlines %>%
  anti_join(flights %>% filter(origin == "LGA"), by = join_by(carrier))
```

# التمرين 5: النصوص والعوامل والتواريخ

## 5.1

```{r}
airlines <- airlines %>%
  mutate(short_name = name %>%
           str_remove_all("\\b(Inc\\.|Co\\.|Corporation)") %>%
           str_squish())
airlines
```

## 5.2

```{r}
planes <- flights %>%
  distinct(tailnum) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tailnum)) %>%
  mutate(tail_num    = as.integer(str_extract(tailnum, "\\d+")),
         ends_letters = str_detect(tailnum, "[A-Z]{2}$"))

planes %>% head()
planes %>% count(ends_letters)
```

## 5.3

```{r}
top5 <- flights %>% count(carrier, sort = TRUE) %>% head(5) %>% pull(carrier)

flights %>%
  filter(carrier %in% top5, !is.na(dep_delay)) %>%
  left_join(airlines, by = join_by(carrier)) %>%
  mutate(short_name = fct_reorder(short_name, dep_delay, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay), .by = c(short_name, month)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mean_dep_delay, colour = short_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  labs(colour = NULL, y = "Mean departure delay (min)")
```

## 5.4

```{r}
flights %>%
  mutate(week = floor_date(time_hour, unit = "week")) %>%
  count(week) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Flights per week")
```

# التمرين 6: purrr والدوال

## 6.1

```{r}
top_n_by <- function(data, var, n = 3, ...) {
  data %>%
    slice_max({{ var }}, n = n, by = c(...))
}

flights %>%
  top_n_by(dep_delay, 2, origin) %>%
  select(origin, carrier, flight, dep_delay)
```

## 6.2

```{r}
flights %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay), !is.na(arr_delay)) %>%
  nest(.by = origin) %>%
  mutate(n   = map_int(data, nrow),
         cor = map_dbl(data, \(d) cor(d$dep_delay, d$arr_delay))) %>%
  select(-data)
```

## 6.3

```{r, fig.height = 3}
plots <- flights %>%
  filter(between(dep_delay, -20, 120)) %>%
  group_split(origin) %>%
  map(\(d) ggplot(d, aes(x = dep_delay)) +
              geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) +
              labs(title = unique(d$origin)))

plots[[1]]
plots[[3]]
```

# المشروع الختامي

```{r}
# 1. القراءة
flights  <- read_csv("data/flights.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(),
                                      flight = col_character(),
                                      time_hour = col_datetime()))
airlines <- read_csv("data/airlines.csv", col_types = "cc")

# 2. التنظيف
on_time <- flights %>%
  filter(!is.na(arr_delay)) %>%
  mutate(on_time = arr_delay <= 15) %>%
  # 3. الربط والاسم القصير
  left_join(airlines, by = join_by(carrier), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(airline = name %>%
           str_remove_all("\\b(Inc\\.|Co\\.|Corporation)") %>%
           str_squish()) %>%
  # 4. التلخيص
  summarise(n = n(), p_on_time = mean(on_time), .by = c(airline, month))

# 5. الجدول العريض
report <- on_time %>%
  mutate(p_on_time = round(100 * p_on_time, 1)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = p_on_time,
              names_prefix = "m", names_sort = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(m1))
report

# 6. الرسم
top6 <- on_time %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .by = airline) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 6) %>%
  pull(airline)

on_time %>%
  filter(airline %in% top6) %>%
  mutate(airline = fct_reorder(airline, p_on_time, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = p_on_time, colour = airline)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(colour = NULL, y = "On-time arrivals (<= 15 min)", x = "Month")

# 7. الحفظ
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(report, "output/on_time_by_carrier.csv")
```

الإجابة: رتب الشركات حسب متوسط `p_on_time`:

```{r}
on_time %>%
  summarise(flights = sum(n),
            p_on_time = weighted.mean(p_on_time, n), .by = airline) %>%
  arrange(desc(p_on_time))
```
